CFML Language Reference: Functions

FirstDayOfMonth

Returns the day-of-the-year number (1-366) of the first day of the month in which a date falls. It does not return a date or a weekday.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

FirstDayOfMonth(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number: 1 for any date in January, 32 for February, 60 for March (61 in a leap year), and so on.

Usage

To get the first of the month as a date, use CreateDate(Year(d), Month(d), 1). To find which weekday the month starts on (useful for drawing a calendar), wrap that in DayOfWeek.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET D = CreateDate(2000, 3, 15)>
<CFSET First = CreateDate(Year(D), Month(D), 1)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>FirstDayOfMonth(March 15, 2000)</TD><TD>#FirstDayOfMonth(D)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>FirstDayOfMonth(March 15, 1999)</TD><TD>#FirstDayOfMonth("3/15/1999")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>First of the month as a date</TD><TD>#DateFormat(First, "mmmm d, yyyy")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>...falls on a</TD><TD>#DayOfWeekAsString(DayOfWeek(First))#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

DayOfYear, DaysInMonth, CreateDate, DayOfWeek
